sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes; if the order hasn't claimed it by then, it goes back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Reserved before charging. If any line is short, nothing is reserved, no payment is requested, Order cancels as short stock, tells the customer which items are short, and the cart is unchanged.
sonnet.q3: The idempotency key (the order id) is sent with every charge request, so a retry with the same key can never charge twice.
sonnet.q4: The customer is refunded the full amount (Payment refunds), the order is cancelled as out of stock, the customer is emailed, and the cart is left alone. No partial orders ship.
sonnet.q5: The cart is emptied when the order is confirmed (on the OrderConfirmed event). If checkout fails (short stock, declined, out of stock) the cart is left unchanged.
sonnet.q6: NOT STATED. The document does not name an orchestrator; steps are triggered by requests and events. It says nothing about a single record of a checkout's progress beyond per-service statuses (Order status PENDING/CONFIRMED in Order DB, payment status PENDING in Payment DB).
sonnet.q7: The provider calls Payment by webhook; Payment then publishes a PaymentSucceeded event on the shared broker, which starts the order confirmation step (Inventory and Order). For declines, Payment's declined result leads to Order cancelling and Inventory releasing the hold.
sonnet.q8: Payment checks whether it has already seen the webhook id (ids stored in Payment DB). If seen, it ignores the duplicate; if not, it saves the id and then acts.
sonnet.q9: Inventory releases the hold, and the order is cancelled as payment declined (cart unchanged). It is triggered by the provider's declined webhook received by Payment. The document does not state the exact message that tells Inventory to release.
sonnet.q10: On PaymentSucceeded, Inventory checks whether the hold is still valid. If valid, it claims the stock and the order is confirmed. If lapsed, Inventory tries to reserve the stock again: if enough stock, the order is confirmed; if not, Payment refunds in full and Order cancels as out of stock.
sonnet.q11: The refund stays PENDING and Payment retries on a timer until it succeeds; after repeated failures a person is alerted. A refund is never dropped. It is tracked in the Payment DB as a refund record with status PENDING. How many retries before alerting is not stated.
sonnet.q12: The OrderConfirmed event causes it, and the Cart service empties the cart (Cart DB). If it fails, the event is redelivered; emptying an already-empty cart does nothing.
